# Team tools

Every incident gets one of four severities: Sev-1, Sev-2, Sev-3, or Sev-4.
Only public or fully synthetic data goes into the hosted service.

## Running the sync agent

Start the agent before you upload anything. Uploads work only when the sync
service is running, and the agent logs each upload to the audit table.

The review takes three days on average. If it takes longer, ask the owner of
the document set what changed.

> Quoted guidance stays in scope: keep the labels verbatim.

- Install the dependencies.
- Start the agent.
- Check the audit table.

See the [handbook](https://example.com/handbook) for the full policy.
